column1: # neurofedora real-data pipeline manifest
# Format (TAB separated, # = comment):
#   <pkg>
# Commands run with cwd = tests/, so use $FIX (the absolute fixtures dir)
# to reference fixtures portably. $TMP is a per-test tmpdir (auto-cleaned).
# Each row becomes a BATS @test that:
#   1. skips if <pkg> isn't installed (so partial installs are graceful),
#   2. runs the command,
#   3. matches <expected pattern> (POSIX regex) against combined stdout+stderr.
# Empty <expected> = "just require exit 0".
# A leading + on a pkg name means "skip if any of these alternative packages
# are missing"  (not yet implemented — placeholder for future multi-pkg pipes).
# Mark in-progress / known-failing rows with `# WIP:` to disable.
dcmtk
dcmtk

column1: # fsleyes render uses GLX even in headless mode — needs a real X display.
# We accept SKIP (no xvfb-run) or a successful render (file >= 1 KB).
python3-fsleyes
column2: command -v xvfb-run >/dev/null || { echo "SKIP: xvfb-run missing"; exit 0; }; out="$TMP/render.png"; timeout 45 xvfb-run -a fsleyes render -of "$out" "$FIX/t1.nii.gz" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; sz=$(wc -c <"$out" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); [ "$sz" -gt 1000 ] && echo "rendered $sz bytes" || echo "RENDER_EMPTY size=$sz"

# ─── Real-data robotics (DART URDFs via urdfdom) ───────────────────────────
# DART ships a curated URDF test corpus under data/urdf/test/; we fetch a
# few canonical valid ones (primitive_geometry, joint_properties, testWorld,
# issue838) for urdfdom's check_urdf parser. Output: "Successfully Parsed XML"
# on valid input.
# testWorld.urdf is a multi-robot WORLD file (root <world>), not a URDF
# (root <robot>) — check_urdf correctly rejects it. issue838.urdf is a
# bug-regression URDF with a single robot definition; we use that instead.
urdfdom
urdfdom
urdfdom
# ─── Real-data cellular modeling (MorpheusML examples) ────────────────────
# Upstream Examples/ — fetched two minimal models (a 1D PDE activator-
# inhibitor and a classic 2D cell-sorting CPM). Each is a full MorpheusML
# XML with <MorpheusModel> root. Verified via Python's stdlib xml parser
# (catches structural drift in the XML schema without needing morpheus's
# own pugixml-based loader).
morpheus
morpheus
# ─── Real-data genomics (BED → BigBed via ucsc-kent-utils) ────────────────
# Synthesized 5-region BED-6 file + chrom.sizes for chr1/chr2. Exercises
# bedToBigBed's parser, sort, and binary writer.
# -type=bed6 tells bedToBigBed our input is the standard BED-6 schema
# (chrom, start, end, name, score, strand) — without this it asks for
# an AutoSql schema file we'd have to ship separately.
ucsc-kent-utils

python3-vmtk
